reviews.text: Had a great experience taking our westie to Mucki Pups. They did a fantastic job, especially considering it was her first time to the groomers and with a long lockdown coat too. Will definitely be going back!

Daisy has been groomed at Muckipups since she was a puppy. Despite the fact that she’s not really a fan of being groomed. Chris and Julie always take lots of care to make her relaxed and she always comes out looking and smelling lovely. Thank you both

Another great bath and groom by Chris and Julie. Always a good experience for my little dog Snowball,  they do a brilliant job on him and he always comes out looking fantastic.
I can’t praise Mucki Pups up enough they make a good team and offer a great service and are always both so welcoming.
If you don’t go there already,  definitely give them a try.

We have 2 dogs a very bouncy cocker spanial and a little shiatsu.
Both dogs are groomed regularly ay Muckypups and always come out looking fab.
The couple are a super pair who obviously  share a love of dogs.
I hope we will still using muckypups for a long time to come.

We used Mukki Pups Wedding Chaperone service. Sarah was amazing, looking after Maisy and Riley for us all day, so us and our family could relax on the day and not have to worry about them and also so they got their much needed down time as …
Take really good care of our dog and do a really fabulous job clearing his matted hair.
